milestones.milestone_title: Alon's lower bound, the half we can state without the theta function
milestones.milestone_description: Exhibit, for every $n$, a system of $n$ unit vectors whose non-orthogonality graph is triangle-free and whose sum has norm at least $cn^{2/3}$. Alon builds it from an explicit Ramsey graph and an orthonormal labeling. He gets the labeling from the definition of $\theta$.
